actions.action: Check whether the specks wipe off
Isolate the plant from other houseplants
Spray plant hard with water focusing on leaf undersides
Spray insecticidal soap or neem oil on both leaf sides, repeating every 5-7 days for 3 weeks
Hang yellow sticky traps near the plant
Remove heavily infested leaves and bag them
Vacuum fallen debris and wipe nearby surfaces
Check product labels for edible-plant use
Regularly check leaf undersides for new eggs

reason: The answer diagnoses whiteflies rather than aphids, but neem oil (the fix that worked) is offered as one option among several treatments, and nothing it recommends would harm the plant.
